title: Stage 5.4 Amendment 2 — Guarded / Constrained EMA v1 Formal Preregistration (TS-0 / TS-1 / TS-2 / TS-3, Full Dev166 + Confirmatory Dev142)

preregistration.timing: This protocol is frozen before any TS-3 Full Dev166 Formal aggregate exists or is read. No Formal result may be consulted during preparation; gates are not adjusted after Formal begins.
preregistration.ts3_algorithm_commit: feat(stage5): add constrained ema temporal stabilization
preregistration.formal_execution_head_policy: The future run_manifest git_head must equal the final preregistration commit that carries this protocol and its config binding; any later code change requires STOP and a new preregistration.
preregistration_evidence_chain: stage5_4_formal protocol SHA 990afcfe697d82bf89573d08b81217a7b9c91fc4d3b60d8a4d63081e32581e51 (TS-1 Formal, execution head 172aef8)
stage5_4_amendment2_smoke protocol SHA 63c714264161fd9130891a044671b9d34c6032a6d75a109cbb8ef160b75c1770 (TS-3 Smoke, all gates PASS, exit 0)

research_question: Does the frozen parameter-free constrained EMA (TS-3, guarded_constrained_ema_v1) retain the temporal-stabilization benefit of fixed EMA (TS-1) while repairing its worst spatial lag on the full frozen Dev166, measured against TS-0 and against the TS-2 motion-adaptive ablation?
hypothesis: H1 (temporal): TS-3 retains material temporal benefit versus TS-0 — at the level TS-1 showed on Full Dev166 (displacement mean reduction about 40%, acceleration mean reduction about 59%) and clearly above TS-2's ablated benefit (about 10%/13% on Smoke).

H2 (spatial repair): TS-3 keeps subject-center containment at 1.0 by construction and strictly reduces the TS-1 strong-off-center visibility regression (Full Dev166 TS-1 delta was -0.071204; Dev142 -0.080256); the residual strong-motion loss is expected to be nonzero because the guard repairs center containment only, not visible fraction >= 0.90.

H3 (ablation ordering): TS-3 is no worse than TS-2 on mean displacement, mean acceleration and >0.20 large jumps, while matching TS-2's containment recovery — i.e. the projection keeps the TS-2 spatial repair without returning the TS-2 temporal benefit.

H4 (guard behavior): On Full Dev166 the guard remains a low-frequency, bounded-magnitude intervention; its true activation rate and correction distribution on strong-motion frames are unknown until Formal and are reported as diagnostics only.

in_scope: read-only consumption of the frozen Stage 5.1/5.2/5.3 Full-Dev artifacts
TS-0/TS-1/TS-2/TS-3 four-arm matched evaluation over the same frozen frame identity
Full Dev166 and Confirmatory Dev142 aggregates as independent post-processing of the same Formal output
out_of_scope: any new detector or scene-cut logic

scientific_variables.ts0: Stage 5.3 FINAL FROZEN CMP-1 (primary_subject_shifted_max_ratio_crop_v1); no temporal smoothing
scientific_variables.ts1: ema_crop_center_v1; fixed alpha=0.5 EMA over the sanitized primary-subject center, re-placed with the frozen Stage 5.3 floor/clamp geometry
scientific_variables.ts2: motion_adaptive_ema_v1; unchanged ablation reference (alpha_min=0.5; linear m in (0.10, 0.20); m >= 0.20 -> alpha_t = 1.0)
scientific_variables.ts3: guarded_constrained_ema_v1; the exact TS-1 EMA proposal plus a parameter-free current-frame center-containment projection
scientific_variables.only_changed_variable_vs_ts1: output placement projection only; EMA state, alpha, input signal, reset policy, crop dimensions and all frozen composition semantics are unchanged

ts3_guard_constraint.definition: For every non-fallback frame the current frozen sanitized primary-subject center must lie inside the final half-open crop rectangle [x, x+Cw) x [y, y+Ch).
ts3_guard_constraint.projection: x3 = clip(x_ema, Lx, Ux); y3 = clip(y_ema, Ly, Uy) with Lx = max(0, floor(px - Cw) + 1), Ux = min(W - Cw, floor(px)), Ly = max(0, floor(py - Ch) + 1), Uy = min(floor(H - Ch), floor(py))
ts3_guard_constraint.state_feedback: corrected placement is output-only and never fed back into the EMA state
ts3_guard_constraint.fallback: no guard on fallback frames; frozen center crop and state clearing inherited exactly

reset_rules.NEW_VIDEO: EMA state never crosses video_id boundaries
reset_rules.FRAME_GAP_GT_1: reset when the gap between consecutive frozen frame ids is greater than 1
reset_rules.FALLBACK: fallback frame emits the frozen center crop and clears state; the next non-fallback frame restarts from its own frozen center
reset_rules.scene_or_shot_reset: NONE; no new reset is introduced

unchanged: sanitized frozen primary subject and bbox
crop width, derived crop height, target ratio 9:16

smoke24_evidence_and_exclusion.exclusion_rule: Confirmatory Dev142 = Frozen Dev166 minus ALL 24 whole video_ids of the SHA-frozen Smoke24 manifest (whole-video exclusion, not per-frame exclusion); 166 - 24 = 142 videos.
smoke24_evidence_and_exclusion.exclusion_verified_locally: The 24 excluded video_ids in the Formal config were byte-verified against the archived Smoke24 manifest copy (semantic and file SHA re-verified 2026-09-10).
smoke24_evidence_and_exclusion.role: identity-only exclusion source; never used to alter any treatment

ts3_smoke_result_binding.guard_activation: 10 / 756 non-fallback frames (1.32%); horizontal only; correction mean 26.4 px / max 61 px

metrics.temporal_displacement: |cx_t - cx_(t-1)| / W over adjacent non-fallback frozen frame pairs (gap == 1); mean, median, P90, P95, max; large jump ratios at >0.10, >0.20, >0.30 (frozen thresholds, complete reuse)
metrics.temporal_acceleration: |(cx_t - cx_(t-1)) - (cx_(t-1) - cx_(t-2))| / W over adjacent non-fallback triplets; mean, median, P90, P95, max
metrics.comparison_sets: paired transitions/triplets only; TS-1/TS-2/TS-3 reset steps counted over all frames and reported separately
metrics.spatial_warning: containment = 1.0 is a construction guarantee of TS-3 and does NOT imply visible-fraction recovery; visible >= 0.90 and mean visible fraction are independently examined

strata_thresholds.frozen: identical to Stage 5.4 Smoke and TS-1 Formal; no re-bucketing after Formal

metrics.strata_output: per analysis set, per stratum: N, TS-0/TS-1/TS-2/TS-3 mean visible fraction, and TS-1/TS-2/TS-3 delta vs TS-0

guard_formal_diagnostics.role: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; no promotion gate derives from guard diagnostics
required_outputs: guard activation count and ratio (non-fallback frames)
continuous guard-run count and max consecutive guard-run length
correction magnitude mean / median / P90 / P95 / max
per-stratum activation rate and correction magnitude
per analysis set: Full Dev166 and Confirmatory Dev142
guard_formal_diagnostics.smoke_to_full_question: The Formal report must explicitly discuss the relation between guard frequency, correction magnitude, temporal penalty and strong-motion spatial recovery; the Smoke rate (1.32%) is not assumed to generalize.

multi_subject_diagnostics.role: OBSERVATION_ONLY; may not be converted into a promotion gate

fallback_semantics.inheritance: frozen Stage 5.2/5.3 fallback semantics fully inherited; guard never acts on fallback frames
fallback_semantics.verification: TS-1/TS-2/TS-3 fallback placement must equal TS-0 on every fallback frame

decision_rule.application: Every gate below is evaluated independently on Full Dev166 and Confirmatory Dev142; both analysis sets must pass. TS-3 is the treatment arm; TS-0 is the control. No gate may be changed after Formal begins.
decision_rule.gate_provenance: The thresholds are the exact values preregistered for the Stage 5.4 TS-1 Formal and reused unchanged by the TS-3 Smoke; no gate is added, removed, or relaxed for TS-3.
amendment2_mechanism_checks_per_analysis: Every non-fallback TS-3 crop contains the current frozen primary-subject center.
TS-3 strong-off-center visible-fraction delta versus TS-0 is strictly better than TS-1 on the same frames.
TS-3 mean displacement is no worse than TS-2 on the same frames.
TS-3 mean acceleration is no worse than TS-2 on the same frames.
TS-3 >0.20 jump ratio is no worse than TS-2 on the same frames.
decision_rule.overall_decision: PASS requires every engineering gate, every frozen temporal and spatial gate on TS-3 vs TS-0 on BOTH analysis sets, and every mechanism check on BOTH analysis sets.

frame identity complete over all 51256 frozen frames; missing = 0; extra = 0; duplicates = 0
invalid crop = 0; out-of-bounds = 0; ratio violations = 0 (all four arms)
crop size unchanged on every frame (TS-1/TS-2/TS-3 vs TS-0)
fallback placement unchanged on every fallback frame (TS-1/TS-2/TS-3 vs TS-0)
TS-0 frozen regression = 0 (recomputed CMP-0 equals the frozen Stage 5.1 crop)
TS-1 regression = 0 and TS-2 regression = 0 versus their frozen Smoke semantics (same algorithm, parameters and reset rules)
Stage 5.1/5.2 frozen artifacts unmodified (byte and semantic SHA re-verification)

frozen manifest / protocol / config identity bound in run_manifest
protocol and config snapshots included in the artifact manifest

determinism.method: Pure CPU arithmetic over SHA-frozen inputs; an in-process replay of the full TS-0/TS-1/TS-2/TS-3 pipeline must reproduce the canonical semantic SHA of every shard record.
determinism.byte_identity: Per-video shard JSON files are written atomically; where outputs are byte-identical across replays the file SHA-256 is additionally retained in shard status.
determinism.no_detector_rerun: Determinism never re-runs RT-DETR; all treatment inputs are frozen artifacts.

resume.runtime: RunContext + ShardStore with strict identity checks; completed per-video shards are reused only under the same immutable identity
forbidden: deleting shards to fake a fresh run

runtime_contract.launch_provenance: launch_source / launch_mode / interactive_child / target are recorded in run_manifest only and never enter the scientific identity or semantic hashes
runtime_contract.output_collision: A non-resume start refuses an existing output identity; no overwrite, reset, clean, or automatic deletion.

formal_complete_requires_all_of: all 166 per-video shards written and identity-verified
post-processing complete (aggregates, strata, guard, multi-subject, fallback diagnostics)
Full Dev166 aggregate and Confirmatory Dev142 aggregate produced
all preregistered scientific gates evaluated on both analysis sets
completion_criteria.progress_semantics: 51256/51256 progress alone is NOT completion; lifecycle completion is authoritative in status.json and run_manifest.finished_at only after post-processing succeeds.

final_freeze_criteria.no_automatic_freeze: Even on exit code 0 with every gate PASS, the executing agent must NOT enter FINAL_FROZEN or commit a freeze automatically.
final_freeze_criteria.human_review_required: After Formal completes, evidence goes to human review; the executing agent may only report READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW.
final_freeze_criteria.report_location: The human report is written directly as amendment2_formal/experiment_report.md in the Stage 5.4 archive; existing smoke/, formal/, amendment_smoke/, amendment2_smoke/ reports are never modified.

failure_semantics.gate_fail: A FAIL on any preregistered gate is a final result for this protocol; it may not be repaired by changing gates, alpha, the guard, datasets, or exclusions after Formal. Any next mechanism requires a new preregistration.
failure_semantics.engineering_fail: An engineering failure (identity, hash, drift) stops the run; resume is allowed only under the same immutable identity.
failure_semantics.stop_conditions: The executor must STOP without running Formal if the protocol/config identity cannot be verified, frozen inputs drift, or AutoDL and origin/master are not at the same execution HEAD.

interpretation_boundary: A PASS supports constrained-EMA temporal stabilization on frozen Dev166 under these metrics only; it does not claim official competition-score improvement.

TS-3 targets the TS-1-level temporal benefit plus repaired worst-case spatial lag; it is not claimed to eliminate all spatial loss, and the visible >= 0.90 regression is expected to persist partially.
No claim about Heldout or generalization beyond Dev166 is permitted.
Confirmatory Dev142 is still a development subset, not Heldout.
